title: Queen City By The Sea | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Queen City by the Sea,' a thoughtfully curated Inlet Beach retreat. Designed for guests who appreciate modern comfort paired with effortless coastal living, this newly built home offers a relaxed yet polished escape just moments from the Gulf. Inside, Queen City by the Sea showcases a clean, contemporary aesthetic layered with warm textures and designer finishes throughout. The open-concept living space flows seamlessly from the kitchen to the dining and living areas, creating an inviting setting for shared meals, conversation, and unwinding after sun-filled days along the coast. With four well-appointed bedrooms and three full bathrooms, the home comfortably accommodates up to ten guests, ideal for families, couples, or a laid-back getaway with friends. Tucked within a quiet, upscale community, guests enjoy access to a community pool and the ease of a short cruise to the beach, where sugar-white sand and emerald waters await. For those who love to explore, four complimentary adult bikes make it easy to experience 30A at a local pace, whether you’re cruising scenic coastal paths, riding to nearby cafés, or heading out for an evening adventure. The location truly sets this home apart. Just half a mile from 30Avenue, you’ll find a vibrant mix of dining, boutique shopping, and entertainment, perfect for morning coffee runs, casual lunches, or evenings out. Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach are also just a short bike ride away, placing some of 30A’s most iconic town centers right at your fingertips. Whether you’re enjoying quiet mornings on the patio, biking toward the sunset, or simply soaking in the calm of this coastal community, Queen City by the Sea offers a seamless blend of modern style, walkable convenience, and beachside tranquility. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Easy 5-minute stroll to the Gulf- toes in the sand in no time -Community pool access for laid back afternoons to home -4 complimentary adult bikes to explore Scenic 30A like a local -Two dedicated parking spots for added convenience -Gas grill + private back patio- perfect for casual cookouts and relaxed evenings -Outdoor shower to rinse off after beach days -Beach gear included for effortless days by the water -Full-size washer & dryer for longer stays and easy packing -Dedicated workspace for remote work or quick check-ins -Bay access on the west side of the neighborhood- ideal for fishing or kayaking (gear not included) -Inlet Beach access just a short walk away -Only ½ mile to 30Avenue for dining, shopping, and entertainment -Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach are an easy bike ride away ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 10 Bedroom #1: King, Ensuite Bathroom Bedroom #2: King, Ensuite Bathroom Bedroom#3: (2) Twin/Twin Bunks Bedroom #4: King BEACH ACCESS Three access points, just a short walk or bike from the home: 1. Inlet Beach Public Access. This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. This beach access is one of our personal favorites and a short bike ride away! 2. Wall Street Beach Public Access. This access is at the end of South Wall Street. About 200 yards east of the intersection of Scenic 30A and Hwy 98, turn south on to South Wall Street then proceed two blocks to the dead end at the gulf. There is no parking but there is plenty of parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access. 3. Winston Lane Public Access. Located less than .3 away. This access is on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary. There is not public parking available, but plenty of bike racks if you choose to ride a bike. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two parking spaces available (2 driveway). No street parking allowed. Included are 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. Additional cleaning charges of $500 will be charged if in violation. *Capacity for 2 vehicles in the driveway. No street parking allowed. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Space must remain pet free! IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver's license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
